description: Pick a numeric value by dragging, track or keyboard.

howToUse: Use it for a value where the position matters more than the exact number: volume, opacity, intensity.
Give it a `label`; use `hideLabel` in compact bars, where the name stays only for screen readers.
Use `marks` when only a few steps are valid (1 to 5), and `ticks` to name the ends ("Shallow", "Deep").

keyboard.action: Moves one step. With `Shift`, ten steps.
Goes to the lowest or highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard and value grid increment. Default 1.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Control name, shown above the track.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Keeps `label` as the accessible name without showing it (compact bars, such as a player's).

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the value in the readout and in `aria-valuetext` (e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Mono pill with the current value. Default `true` when there is a `label`.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Captions at the ends of the track (e.g. ["Shallow", "Deep"]).

props.name: marks
props.description: Discrete slider: one label per step, draws the points and the label ruler.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
